chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:
Beware of the marriages of the women who are divorced upon other than the Sunnah.
I said to him, 'Supposing a man from them divorces his wife and there is a need for me with her?'

He said, 'So meet up with him after he has divorced her, and she has observed her waiting period with her companions, so you should be saying to him, 'You have divorced so and so?' So if he says, 'Yes', so it has become one divorce upon a pure period. So leave her from when he divorced her with that divorce until she has observed her waiting period. Then marry her, so that divorce would have made her to be irrevocably divorced'.
ai.seo_question: How to legally remarry a woman who was divorced before her waiting period ended?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the mechanism of 'Talaq al-Sunnah' by distinguishing between a divorce during menstruation (which is irregular) and one during purity; by verifying the latter, the initial divorce is counted as the first, allowing for a subsequent marriage that becomes irrevocably binding after the 'Iddah. This ruling ensures the woman’s status is regularized according to the Prophetic tradition, preventing the complications of triple divorce in one sitting. It highlights the Shia emphasis on precise temporal conditions in marital jurisprudence to maintain the sanctity and stability of the family unit.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Usman Bin Isa, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Beware of the marriages of the women divorced upon other than the Sunnah’.
I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Supposing a man from them divorces his wife and there is a need for me with her?’

He<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘So meet up with him after he has divorced her, and she has observed her waiting period with her companions, so you should be saying to him, ‘You have divorced so and so?’ So if he says, ‘Yes’, so it has become one divorce upon a pure period. So leave her from when he divorced her with that divorce until she has observed her waiting period. Then marry her, so that divorce would have made her to be irrevocably divorced’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from certain persons of our people who have said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must remain on your guard in the case of married women who are divorced against the Sunnah.’
I asked him (the Imam) that a man has divorced his wife and I am interested.

He (the Imam) said, ‘Meet him after he divorces her and waiting period is complete with him then ask him, ‘Have you divorced so and so?’ If he said, ‘Yes, I have divorced her’, this is one divorce during a menses free period. From the time he has divorced her until waiting period is complete then you can marry and divorce has made them complete strangers to each other.’”
